title: Prolactin
what: This is a blood test from a vein. It shows your level of prolactin, a hormone that affects the menstrual cycle and the breasts.
why: For irregular periods, infertility, discharge from the breasts, headaches, and in men, low sex drive.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: What medicines you take. Many of them affect prolactin
If you are pregnant or breastfeeding
Your cycle day, if you are a woman

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: Usually in the morning, 2 to 3 hours after waking up. Your doctor will tell you the cycle day.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: No sex, no sauna, no hard workouts, and no alcohol. Do not touch or massage your breasts.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually fasting: no food for 8 to 12 hours. Plain water is fine. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything should change.

steps: Before the draw, sit quietly for 15 to 30 minutes
You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tightened above your elbow
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick, and blood fills a tube
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes and keep your arm straight
You can eat right away and go back to your usual day
Results usually come in 1 to 3 days. The lab will tell you when
If prolactin is high, the doctor often asks you to repeat the test. Stress can easily raise it

faq.q: Why can prolactin be high without illness?
faq.a: Stress, sleep, sex, exercise, and medicines can raise it. That is why following the prep matters.

faq.q: Which cycle day is best for prolactin?
faq.a: Usually early in the cycle, but your doctor will tell you the exact day.

reminders.text: Prolactin test tomorrow. Today, no sex, sauna, or workouts. Do not eat after dinner.
